poem.line1: It is a rugged yet magnificent land,
poem.line2: Where between two mountains stretches a sea of vines.
poem.line3: A land of light and people,
poem.line4: With elders who speak, seated on their bench.
poem.line5: Behind each vine stock lies a memory,
poem.line6: The sum of doubts and a thousand hopes,
poem.line7: The memory of work, of joy, of laughter.
poem.line9: Listen to the frozen words whispered by the north wind,
poem.line10: My eyes drowned in the crimson of the summer sun,
poem.line11: I walk among rows and goblet vines,
poem.line12: I try, I sow, I live, I write in wine the stories of this place.

privacy.metaDescription: How we collect, use and protect your personal data (GDPR).
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We care deeply about your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, the purposes and legal bases, how long we keep it and your rights.

sections.title: 1. Controller
paragraphs: Domaine Berthuit – BERTHUIT LUCAS, 11 Rue du Onze Novembre 1918, 11700 Pépieux – France. SIRET: 987 552 056. Email: lucas@domaineberthuit.com.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
list: Account: username, email, password (bcrypt-hashed), role, email verification status.
Contact details (optional): first/last name, address, phone.
Orders: items, amounts, shipping/billing addresses, status.
Communications: transactional emails (verification, reset), contact messages.
Security: IP, user-agent, session/JWT identifiers, CSRF tokens, technical logs, anti-abuse counters.

sections.title: 3. Purposes & legal bases
list: Marketing (consent) — by default, no ads or analytics.

sections.title: 4. Recipients
paragraphs: Access is limited to authorized personnel. We may use processors: hosting/maintenance, transactional email, payments (e.g., Stripe if enabled), logistics. They act under our instructions.

sections.title: 5. Transfers outside the EU
paragraphs: Where providers are outside the EU, we rely on appropriate safeguards (EU SCCs or adequacy). Details available upon request.

sections.title: 6. Retention
list: Account: while active, then deletion on request or after 3 years of inactivity.
Support messages: 3 years after last contact.
Security logs: up to 6 months unless required longer.
Security tokens/cookies: access JWT ~15 min; refresh_token 7 days (httpOnly, /auth); CSRF token session.

sections.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: HTTPS, bcrypt-hashed passwords, server hardening (Helmet, HPP), CSRF (double-submit), httpOnly cookies, rate-limiting, role-based access, server-side XSS sanitization.

sections.title: 8. Your rights (GDPR)
paragraphs: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection and post-mortem directives. Contact: lucas@domaineberthuit.com. You may also contact the CNIL (cnil.fr).

sections.title: 9. Minors
paragraphs: This website is intended for adults (18+) only.

sections.title: 10. Payments
paragraphs: If online payments are enabled, they are handled by a third-party (e.g., Stripe). We do not store card data. Please refer to the provider’s privacy policy.

sections.title: 11. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The latest version applies upon publication.

meta.title: FAQ — Domaine Berthuit
meta.description: Frequently asked questions: account, orders, payment, delivery, cookies & privacy.

qa.q: Do I need an account to place an order?
qa.a: Yes. Creating/signing in is required to add to cart and pay, so we can secure your data and let you find your orders.

qa.q: I’m logged out after 10–15 minutes of inactivity. Is that normal?
qa.a: Yes, it’s a security measure. If you weren’t signed in, nothing is lost; just sign in to continue.

qa.q: I can’t sign in / I forgot my password.
qa.a: Use “Forgot password”. You’ll receive a reset link by email (check your spam folder).

qa.q: Can I order without accepting cookies?
qa.a: No. We use essential cookies (security, cart, session). Without consent, only legal pages remain accessible.

qa.q: Why do you ask me to confirm that I’m 18+?
qa.a: Alcohol sales are reserved for adults. By continuing, you confirm you are 18 or older.

qa.q: Which cookies do you use?
qa.a: Only those needed for core features (auth, cart, language) and basic analytics. Details in our [PRIVACY].

qa.q: How can I withdraw my consent?
qa.a: Click the “Cookies” button at the bottom of the page, then “Withdraw my consent”.

qa.q: Do your wines contain sulfites?
qa.a: Like most wines, yes. See each cuvée’s label.

qa.q: Can the vintage change?
qa.a: Yes if the next cuvée is for sale. The product page indicates the shipped vintage.

qa.q: I see “Out of stock” — when will it return?
qa.a: As soon as we restock. You can write to us via [CONTACT] to be notified.

qa.q: Cellaring & serving tips?
qa.a: Each product page includes our recommendations (temperature, ageing, pairings).

qa.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
qa.a: Credit/debit cards via Stripe (secure payment). We never store card data.

qa.q: Can I modify or cancel my order?
qa.a: Write to us as soon as possible. As long as it hasn’t been prepared, we can adjust/cancel it.

qa.q: Do I receive a confirmation?
qa.a: Yes, a summary email is sent right after payment.

qa.q: Do you offer promo codes or gift cards?
qa.a: Occasionally. Subscribe to the newsletter or follow us to be informed.

qa.q: What are delivery times and fees?
qa.a: Generally 48–72h business hours after shipment in mainland France. Fees appear in the cart based on weight and address.

qa.q: Do you ship outside France?
qa.a: Contact us for international shipping; we evaluate case by case.

qa.q: What if my parcel is damaged?
qa.a: Refuse the parcel (or make a precise reservation) and contact us with photos; we’ll find a solution.

qa.q: Can I pick up at the winery?
qa.a: Yes, by appointment. Choose “Pickup at the estate” at checkout.

qa.q: How can I get my invoice?
qa.a: It’s available in My account > Orders. A copy is emailed to you.

qa.q: B2B sales / business invoicing?
qa.a: Write to us via [CONTACT] with your company details; we’ll get back to you quickly.

qa.q: Can we visit the estate?
qa.a: Yes, by appointment. Book via [CONTACT] with your preferred date and number of people.

qa.q: Do you organize tastings?
qa.a: Yes, regularly. We publish the dates on the site and social networks.

qa.q: The “Add to cart” button is disabled.
qa.a: Make sure you’re signed in and have accepted cookies. The product may also be out of stock.

qa.q: I don’t see the language button or some links.
qa.a: Before consent, only Home, [CGU], [CGV], [PRIVACY], [CONTACT] are accessible.

qa.q: I’m not receiving your emails.
qa.a: Check spam/Promotions and add contact@domaineberthuit.com to your contacts.

qa.q: How can I exercise my rights (access, rectification, deletion)?
qa.a: Write to privacy@domaineberthuit.com (or via [CONTACT]). We reply within 30 days.

qa.q: Where can I find your terms and policies?
qa.a: See [CGU], [CGV] and our [PRIVACY].
